failureDescription: Frozen R07 accepts changes to legacy aggregate, upper and lower lip wetness while the active fragment shader does not consume them. Real browser probes of API and trusted UI input reproduce a zero-pixel response. The same upper/lower controls respond in the native material.
mustNeverRepeat: Treat successful state or uniform assignment as proof that the active render path uses the parameter
Use any whole-frame change as proof of a correctly connected mouth control
Silently average independent legacy values into an uncalibrated one-dimensional current control
Reject a preset after it has already modified diagnostics or private undo history
Delete inactive recipe values or block geometric restoration merely because another material is displayed
Treat an unreviewed material or shader hook as a supported consumer
requiredEvidence: Frozen host bytes and a deterministic nonblank real WebGL framebuffer
R07 no-response probes for all three legacy wetness fields, including trusted UI input
A native-material positive control for the same legacy control family
Independent mouth-region measurement and rejected outside-region synthetic counterexamples
Exact candidate/default preservation and exact forwarding to original psWet low/high frames
Atomic rejection, native-material recovery, real archive round trip and geometric undo
Fixed HTTPS bytes, version, startup, key interaction and framebuffer readback
gateLogic: A baseline legacy mouth response disproves the stated defect premise
A failed native positive control makes the evidence inconclusive; it does not prove the absence of the defect
Reject candidate changes to the default person, geometry, lighting, camera or framebuffer
Reject current-control responses differing from original direct psWet endpoint frames
Require zero changes outside the independent ROI when the baseline has zero; otherwise preserve and disclose the exact inherited footprint
Classify browser failure, timeout and incomplete publication separately from product success
Machine success permits a bounded review candidate, without automatically setting visualAcceptance or productionReady
appliesTo: Reviewed R07 and native ET19 material objects and shader hooks
